# Glide fixtures

`20261106_klkr_pattern.csv` — the 2026-11-06 KLKR pattern and landing (runway 06), one row per second
20:01:30-20:06:00Z, from the tablet's flight recording `20261106_KLKR-KLKR.csv` (position, altitude,
ground speed and true track as recorded; altitude is the engine monitor's GPS altitude, which the
glide panel would take from the Stratux). Dana flew this with a screen recording of the engine-out
block; the ground wind was VRB 4 kt. Used by the runway-target tests (see
docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-06-engine-out-glide-runway-target.md): the downwind must be reachable,
the rollout must read OVER the runway.
